integrity: The algebraic transition equations and root counts are replayed exactly with rational arithmetic and Sturm sequences; decimal coordinates are only displays of algebraic roots.
scientific_limitations: The vector field is nondifferentiable at the four axis equilibria, which are excluded from the Jacobian classification.
Purely imaginary transverse eigenvalues are a linear spectral fact and do not prove nonlinear stability or center dynamics.
The result is restricted to the parameter slice a=4 and b=5/2 and does not establish existence or hiddenness of the numerical chaotic attractor.
title: Exact transverse-type partition of the cloud-shaped equilibrium curve
